description:
Keyword research for YouTube. volume: always estimated (YouTube publishes no search
    counts): estimated_monthly_searches with a range, a 0 to 100 score and band, its source
    (Google Trends with the YouTube filter against fixed anchors; or, when Trends is busy,
    YouTube autocomplete and the top results' views) and basis. competition: 0 to 100 counted
    from the top 10 long-form results (big channels, posted in the last year, the keyword in
    the title, how many beat their own channel 2x). score: value 0 to 100 (60% volume, 40% the
    room competition leaves), band very_low, low, medium, high or very_high (vidIQ's brackets)
    and the basis naming its inputs. related, questions, rising: terms from autocomplete and the
    top results' titles, each with its source. Costs 2 credits, refunded when the read fails;
    a bad request is 422 and costs nothing. Takes about 10 to 30 seconds. Same as POST
    /v1/keywords. Read it back with get_call.

country.description: a two-letter country code, default US
country.title: Country

idempotency_key.description: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters; the same key and request within 24 hours answer the saved remix and charge nothing; the same key with another request is 422 idempotency_key_reused
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

keyword.description: the words people would type into YouTube search, 2 to 100 characters
keyword.title: Keyword

language.description: a two-letter language code for the autocomplete, default en
language.title: Language

name: research_keywords
